_approach: Sgija's darker, drum-centric strip-down: melodigging describes it as 'clattering shakers, rimshots and log-drum bass figures' with the jazzy-keys palette pared away - here that means a hard, loud log drum (tomLow at accent velocity), busy dry rimshots, a tom fill every second bar, and almost no kick at all (kicks are optional/sparse in this variant). NOTE: tomLow+congaLow approximate the log drum's RHYTHM only - the real log drum is a tuned, pitch-bent kick/808/bass hybrid this drum-only library cannot reproduce; the melodic/bass part must come from a synth. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
